messages:
mike_sales: Hey team — AcmeP is ready to do a POC. They want a Hosted API key scoped to a sandbox project, plus audit log forwarding into their Splunk instance (TLS syslog), retention 90d, and a short report that keys were rotated during the POC. They also asked whether we can spin up a Dedicated trial pool for 2 weeks to compare latency/cost. Any blockers?

tara_se: Do they want live syslog ingest or periodic S3 exports? live syslog most common but asking to confirm. Also confirm which data fields they need in the audit logs.

jules_security: We can do TLS syslog to customer collector IPs. Notes: 1) We redact full API keys in logs and hash token identifiers; 2) default audit retention is 30d, ops can extend to 90d for a POC with an exception ticket; 3) we can produce a signed rotation event artifact (per-key rotation timestamps) for their report. For the questionnaire: we can supply SOC2 attestation and a redacted penetration test summary.

sam_engops: For Hosted POC keys we can create a scoped, rate-limited key with IP allowlist and TTL (we usually set TTL=7d for POC). To enable syslog forwarding for a project you can hit the control plane API:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/{proj}/logging/forwarding \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"type":"syslog-tls","endpoint":"splunk.acme.com:6514","allowed_ips":["203.0.113.45"],"format":"json-v2"}'
```
We will mask email/usernames in the JSON payload by default. For Dedicated trial: we have a 2-week eval option but it requires a minimal reserved commit signed off by finance (we can use a temporary promo credit to offset). Private/VPC is not realistic inside 2 weeks — typical lead time is 4–6 weeks.

mike_sales: Good, can you confirm which security questionnaire fields we should prefill? They flagged: "Log retention and export", "Key rotation evidence", "KMS usage", and "Network allowlisting". Also pricing owner: can we give an estimate for a two-week Dedicated trial (8x A100-equivalent)?

jules_security: Prefill recommendations: - Log retention: we will mark as configurable, default 30d, POC exception 90d (ops ticket required). - Key rotation: we will provide rotation artifact (timestamp + rotated-by) and recommend short TTL keys. - KMS: we use customer-managed KEKs in Private but not for Hosted; for Hosted we store envelope keys in our KMS (we will mark controls and offer redaction options). - Network allowlisting: supported for API and log egress.

sam_engops: Pricing estimate (very rough): 2-week Dedicated trial on a small pool (8x A100-equivalent, 24/7) ~ $12k list for the period; with a trial promo credit we can subsidize ~$10k -> share exact quote via sales ops.

deploy-bot: splunk-forwarder-config-v1 deployed to staging at 1765432150 :white_check_mark:

elaine_ps: I'll own the POC runbook and access matrix. Action items I need: customer Splunk endpoint + TLS cert, collector IPs, customer contact for escalation, and whether they want raw request bodies in logs (we should avoid PII). I'll make an onboarding checklist.

mike_sales: Customer will send endpoint + cert today. They asked also: can we provide a short attestation that we won't use POC data to train models? Answer?

jules_security: Yes — for Hosted POC we can sign an attestation: "redwood will not use customer POC data to improve models; logs used only for ops and compliance per agreement". I'll draft wording.

mike_sales: Awesome — thanks all, I'll collect the Splunk details and forward. :thumbsup:
